summary.plain: The physicists who built and ran the LSND neutrino detector at Los Alamos National Laboratory from 1993 to 1998.
summary.technical: Collaboration (approximately 32 authors across 13 institutions on its main detector paper) that proposed the LSND experiment in 1989, built the 167 t liquid-scintillator detector at LAMPF/LANSCE, and operated it from 1993 to 1998, reporting evidence for muon-antineutrino to electron-antineutrino oscillation.
